title: The TS collect has no role, so its no-commits rule cannot exempt review-epic the way the Go side's does
body: WorkerTask carries no role, so worker-collect.ts's no-commits checks (both the pre-existing commits===0 check and 94u's report-only check) are unconditional, while the Go executors gate the same checks on NoCommitsIsFailure(role), which exempts review-epic (tick 19l). A review whose only commit is its report would be refused by the TS collect and accepted by the Go one. Latent today — the door has no collect route and reviews collect on the Go side — but the two reads of the same branch disagree for a review, and wiring the role through WorkerTask with the 19l rule recorded where the TS side can read it would close it.
